tool_config.name: submit_count
tool_config.description: Record the counts and checks this store confirmed for the recalled batch of tins. Call it only after every number and answer has been read back and confirmed with a yes, and send the complete set in one call: sold, on_shelf, held, returned and forwarded_qty, with 0 for any the person said was none, plus the three checks when you asked them. After a correction, call it again with the complete corrected set. The reply says whether the counts were accepted. If stop is true, stop asking, thank the person and end the call. If accepted is false and the reply gives two values that disagree, say both plainly and ask them to check again. Otherwise do what the reply's message says.

request_body_schema.description: One store's confirmed counts for the recalled batch, in whole tins, and its checks.

sold.description: Tins of this batch sold to shoppers since the delivery, as the person confirmed, read off the till's item sales report when they could. Send 0 if none sold. Leave it out only if they could not give a number.

on_shelf.description: Tins of this batch still on the shelf, for sale, as the person confirmed. Send 0 if none.

held.description: Tins of this batch pulled from sale and held apart, as the person confirmed. Send 0 if none. Send the three checks with it.

returned.description: Tins of this batch already sent back to the company, as the person confirmed. Send 0 if none were returned. Leave it out only if they could not give a number.

forwarded_qty.description: Tins of this batch passed on to another store, as the person confirmed. Send 0 if none went anywhere.

forwarded_to_name.description: Name of the store the forwarded tins went to, as read back and confirmed with the person. Send it only when forwarded_qty is more than 0; leave it out otherwise.

received_qty.description: Only when the call details say to ask what they received: how many tins of this batch the party received from the party that sent them. Leave it out entirely for every other party, even as 0.

received_from.description: Only for a party that received tins of this batch from more than one sender: the name of the party that sent the tins counted in received_qty, as read back and confirmed. Leave it out otherwise.

batch_seen.description: Only when you asked the three checks: the batch code printed under one tin, letters and digits, as read back and confirmed, for example B-4471. Leave it out otherwise.

sold_source.description: Only when you asked the three checks: till_report if the sold count was read off the till's item sales report, estimate if they could only estimate it. Leave it out otherwise.

block_test.description: Only when you asked the three checks: true if the till refused the sale when one tin was scanned, false if it sold. Leave it out otherwise.

delivery_note.description: The delivery note number exactly as the person confirmed it, letters and digits, for example DN-73105. Send it only when the call details say to ask for the delivery note; leave it out otherwise.

forwards.description: Only when tins went to more than one store: one entry per store with its name and the number of tins, as read back and confirmed. When every store is listed here, leave forwarded_qty and forwarded_to_name out. Leave it out entirely when one store or no store got tins.

items.description: One store that received forwarded tins.

to_name.description: The store's name as read back and confirmed with the person.

qty.description: How many tins went to that store.
